verses.pali: “Yaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavanto pabbajitā gāmaṁ vā nigamaṁ vā upanissāya viharanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, when ethical renunciates are supported by a town or village,

verses.pali: Tattha manussā tīhi ṭhānehi bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavanti.
verses.english: the people there brim with much merit in three ways.
By way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Yaṁ, bhikkhave, sīlavanto pabbajitā gāmaṁ vā nigamaṁ vā upanissāya viharanti.
verses.english: When ethical renunciates are supported by a town or village,

verses.pali: Tattha manussā imehi tīhi ṭhānehi bahuṁ puññaṁ pasavantī”ti.
verses.english: the people there brim with much merit in these three ways.”
